import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static long[] lsc = new long[62], rsc = new long[62], rsc2 = new long[62];
    static char[] s = new char[62];
    static Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> nm = new HashMap<>();
    static Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> mm = new HashMap<>();

    static long comb(int n, int k) {
        if (n < k || k < 0) return 0;
        long rez = 1;
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            rez = rez * (n - i) / (i + 1);
        }
        return rez;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int r = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int c = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int n = 2 * (r + c);
        String line = br.readLine();
        s = line.toCharArray();

        lsc[2 * r - 1] = 1;
        for (int i = 2 * r; i < n; i++) {
            lsc[i] = lsc[i - 1] * i / (i - 2 * r + 1);
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= n; i++) {
            rsc[i] = comb(i, r);
            rsc2[i] = comb(i, r - 1);
        }

        long nsum = rsc[n / 2] * rsc[n / 2];
        long msum = nsum;
        int cnta = 0, cntb = 0;
        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            int ok;
            if (msum > 0) {
                ok = 1;
            } else {
                ok = 0;
            }
            if (cntb == n / 2) {
                ok = 1;
            }
            if (cnta == n / 2) {
                ok = 0;
            }
            if (ok != 0) {
                cnta++;
                msum = msum - rsc2[n / 2 - cnta] * rsc[n / 2 - cntb];
            } else {
                cntb++;
                msum = msum + rsc2[n / 2 - cntb] * rsc[n / 2 - cnta];
            }
        }
        msum = Math.max(msum, -msum);
        Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> currentMap = new HashMap<>();
        currentMap.put(new Pair<>(0L, 0), 1L);
        long rasp = 0;

        for (int i = n - 1; i >= 2 * r - 1; i--) {
            Map<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> newMap = new HashMap<>();
            for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
                long sum = entry.getKey().first;
                int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
                long ncnt = entry.getValue();

                int ast = n / 2 - cnt;
                int bst = i + 1 - ast;

                long asum = sum + rsc2[ast - 1] * rsc[bst];
                long bsum = sum - rsc2[bst - 1] * rsc[ast];

                if (s[i] == 'A') {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key = new Pair<>(asum, cnt + 1);
                    newMap.put(key, newMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + ncnt);
                    key = new Pair<>(bsum, cnt);
                    newMap.put(key, newMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L));
                } else if (s[i] == 'B') {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> key = new Pair<>(asum, cnt + 1);
                    newMap.put(key, newMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L));
                    key = new Pair<>(bsum, cnt);
                    newMap.put(key, newMap.getOrDefault(key, 0L) + ncnt);
                } else {
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyA = new Pair<>(asum, cnt + 1);
                    newMap.put(keyA, newMap.getOrDefault(keyA, 0L) + ncnt);
                    Pair<Long, Integer> keyB = new Pair<>(bsum, cnt);
                    newMap.put(keyB, newMap.getOrDefault(keyB, 0L) + ncnt);
                }
            }
            long nsum = 0;
            for (int i2 = i; i2 >= 0; i2--) {
                nsum += lsc[i2];
            }
            currentMap = newMap;
        }

        long bsum = Long.MAX_VALUE;
        for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
            long val = Math.max(entry.getKey().first, -entry.getKey().first);
            bsum = Math.min(bsum, val);
        }

        for (Map.Entry<Pair<Long, Integer>, Long> entry : currentMap.entrySet()) {
            long sum = entry.getKey().first;
            int cnt = entry.getKey().second;
            if (sum == bsum || sum == -bsum) {
                int sem = 0;
                for (int i2 = 0; i2 < 2 * r - 1; i2++) {
                    if (s[i2] == '?') {
                        sem++;
                    } else if (s[i2] == 'A') {
                        cnt++;
                    }
                }
                long ncnt = entry.getValue() * comb(sem, n / 2 - cnt);
                rasp += ncnt;
            }
        }

        System.out.println(rasp);
    }

    static class Pair<F, S> {
        public final F first;
        public final S second;

        public Pair(F first, S second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }

        @Override
        public boolean equals(Object o) {
            if (!(o instanceof Pair)) return false;
            Pair<?, ?> p = (Pair<?, ?>) o;
            return Objects.equals(first, p.first) && Objects.equals(second, p.second);
        }

        @Override
        public int hashCode() {
            return Objects.hash(first, second);
        }
    }
}
